bugs_found.name: Options pricer expiry-day T collapse
bugs_found.description: time_to_expiry_years() used 'delta_days - 1 + intraday_fraction' where delta_days=0 on expiry day. Result: T = max(-0.771, 1/365) = 1/365 days = 7.5e-6 years. At T=7.5e-6 with IV=14%, ATM options priced at ~₹3-4. But expiry-day morning should give T ≈ 0.23 days → ~₹30. Top 3 affected trades: Mar10 (+₹58k→+₹43k), Mar17 (+₹49k→+₹36k). Total overstatement across 6 months: estimated ₹100k-₹200k.
bugs_found.impact: Inflated P&L on all expiry-day morning trades. Approximately 4 expiry days per month × 6 months = 24 affected sessions.

bugs_found.name: Momentum stop geometry: midpoint instead of candle low
bugs_found.description: Momentum breakout stop was set at bar_low + 0.5*(close-low) = candle midpoint. Should be bar_low (the candle's actual low). The tighter midpoint stop caused rapid stop-outs followed by re-entries on the same zone, inflating trade count 2.6x (270 → 103 per month in February).
bugs_found.impact: 2.6x more trades than realistic. Each quick stop-out also incurred transaction costs, creating a hidden drag partially masked by BUG-001's inflated wins.

leakage_audit.entry_timing: CLEAN — harness enters at bar[i+1] open, never uses current bar close for entry
leakage_audit.pivot_calculation: CLEAN — build_pivot_table() uses .shift(1) throughout (daily, weekly, monthly). Today's pivots = yesterday's OHLC only
leakage_audit.daily_ohlc_injection: CLEAN — pre-fetched daily OHLCV injected once; today's partial bar added to daily df but .shift(1) means it does NOT feed today's levels
leakage_audit.position_sizing: MINOR RISK — uses next-bar open price to size position (peeking one bar ahead for sizing, but sizing doesn't affect entry/exit P&L)

conclusion: HYPOTHESIS REJECTED. The reported +4,026% result is NOT reproducible from current (corrected) code. Two bugs in the original code inflated both trade count and P&L. Current code produces +376% (₹20k→₹95k) — still profitable but 10x lower. HOWEVER: the edge appears REAL. The strategy is consistently profitable in corrected code despite the two bugs being fixed. Research should proceed with the corrected baseline. March 2026 remains an outlier (+322% in corrected run) requiring EXP-0002 investigation.
